about_the_game:
A catastrophic event has shattered a powerful spirit, splitting it into two smaller beings and scattering its immense power across the world. Bound by their shared purpose, the two spirits must embark on a journey to reclaim what has been lost. Take control of both characters simultaneously as you solve challenging puzzles, overcome trials, and uncover the hidden truth behind their shared destiny.

Main Gameplay Features:

Simultaneously guide two spirits with the same movement keys, solving unique puzzles along the way. As one moves, the other follows - together, they must navigate the challenges ahead.

Explore stunning, hand-crafted environments, each brimming with detail and unique atmospheres. Every chapter unfolds its own captivating story, inviting you to discover hidden secrets and experience a world that feels alive with every step.

Discover and unlock new abilities throughout your journey, each offering fresh, creative ways to approach and solve the challenges you’ll encounter along the way.
